one_line: Provides for recognition and enforcement of arbitration agreements and foreign arbitral awards in Pakistan.
summary: This Ordinance facilitates the recognition and enforcement of arbitration agreements and foreign arbitral awards within Pakistan, aligning with the United Nations Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards, 1958. The Ordinance grants exclusive jurisdiction to designated courts to adjudicate matters arising from it and outlines procedures for staying legal proceedings in favor of arbitration.

one_line: Establishes Special Courts to punish holders of representative offices for misconduct committed after December 1970.
summary: This Order punishes holders of representative offices for misconduct committed after December 1970 with imprisonment up to seven years or fines. It defines 'holder of representative office' broadly to include federal and provincial ministers, members of parliament, and other officials. The Order establishes Special Courts with High Court powers to try these offences and creates a presumption of guilt based on disproportionate assets. It also disqualifies convicted persons from election for seven years and allows appeals to the Supreme Court.
